title: Developmentally Appropriate Discipline & Behavior Guidance for Young Children
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units

program.section_heading: Developmentally Appropriate Discipline & Behavior Guidance for Young Children: Certificate of Achievement (Transcripted)
outcomes: Identify developmentally appropriate practices about neurodiversity, how the brain functions, and how the learning environment can be managed to encourage appropriate classroom behaviors.
Apply the principles and tools of brain-based learning strategies to teach new ways of approaching learning while working with groups of young children.

missing_explained.why: not in the text; catalog prints CDEV C1000 Child Growth and Development in its place (likely the renumbered course)

notes: CDEV C1000 is not in the closed list; it appears to be the common-course-numbered successor of CDEV 107 (same title, Child Growth and Development, 3 units). Reviewer should confirm.
Closed list writes 'CDEV229' without a space; matched to catalog's 'CDEV 229' Brain Development and Learning (3 units), treated as the same course.
The first requirement is CDEV C1000 OR APCD 107 OR PSYC 157, recorded as one entry with alternatives.

The summary says the certificate is designed for 'educators, teachers, parents, community stakeholders, and caregivers' who already work with children; these describe the intended audience rather than careers the program leads to, so careers is left empty. Reviewer may wish to check.
Catalog prints 'Total : 11.0' for the block and the certificate.
